title: Chris Bledsoe's inconclusive visit to Skinwalker Ranch was not aired

tellings.quote: He did. We didn't end up airing um that content. Um

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings that has been filmed for television, says that Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him, did visit the ranch in the 2020s. According to Fugal, the visit did not produce clear results, and they did not end up airing that footage.
